{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Deduplicate on patient_id, keeping highest sample_seq for each patient
df_dedup = df.loc[df.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].idxmax()]

# Verify number of unique patients after deduplication
n_unique_patients = len(df_dedup)

# Filter to treatment arm
treatment_arm = df_dedup[df_dedup['arm'] == 'treatment']

# Verify number of patients in treatment arm
n_treatment_patients = len(treatment_arm)

# Calculate response fraction
response_fraction = treatment_arm['responded'].mean()

# Print all required numbers
print(n_unique_patients)
print(n_treatment_patients)
print(response_fraction)"}
